name: Headboard panel
note: glued up from narrower boards; leave 3 mm play in the grooves top and bottom and do not glue it in

name: Head post
note: mortise before shaping; keep the bolt counterbore on the outside face

name: Foot end panel
note: glued up from narrower boards; leave 3 mm play in the grooves top and bottom and do not glue it in

name: Foot post
note: mortise before shaping; keep the bolt counterbore on the outside face

name: Side rail
note: bed bolts pull the joint up; the tenon only locates it

name: Slat bearer
note: glued and screwed to the inside of the rail, flush with nothing -- work off the top edge

name: Centre beam
note: carries the middle of every slat; screw each slat to it

name: Drawer front
note: routed finger pull, radiused; screwed to the box from inside

name: Drawer bottom
note: slides into the grooves as the box goes together
